What if we told you that a swimming pool could become a billion-dollar business?
Iceland's famous Blue Lagoon, which started as an accidental geothermal pool near a power plant, has grown into one of the country's most recognised luxury tourism and wellness brands. Now, the company has entered the stock market with an IPO worth approximately €105 million.
But how did a naturally formed hot-water lagoon turn into a business spanning luxury hotels, restaurants, skincare products, wellness experiences and adventure tourism?
